# Neuro_Nomad Portfolio

> Sovereign systems. Local-first. Forever offline.

Personal portfolio of Neuro_Nomad (GitHub: @AnonymousNomad) — licensed electrician turned self-taught solo developer. Builds offline-first systems where failure is expensive: AI runtimes, training pipelines, low-level OS integration, and security controls that must prove what they did.

## Site

- **URL:** https://anonymousnomad.github.io/
- **Stack:** Plain HTML5 + CSS custom properties + native ES modules. No build step. No framework. No Tailwind. No web fonts. No CDN. No analytics. No cookies. No third-party scripts.
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Source:** https://github.com/AnonymousNomad/anonymousnomad.github.io

## Design tokens

- **Matrix green** `#00FF41` — "system is running" semantic
- **Neon purple** `#A855F7` — section headers, primary accents
- **Neon blue** `#3B82F6` — links, secondary
- **Cyan-400** `#22D3EE` — GhostCode section only
- **Deep black** `#050507` — all backgrounds
- **Off-white** `#E5E7EB` — body text
- **System font stack:** `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Inter, Roboto, sans-serif`

## Sections (top to bottom)

1. **Hero** — AIDE flagship, 9-step closed loop, matrix-green accent
2. **About** — Electrician → AI architect, 3 evidence areas, "How I work" pipeline
3. **AIDE Sovereign Workbench** — flagship, 3 model packs, closed-loop expansion
4. **GhostCode** — concept demo, cyan island, user journey terminal
5. **Vitalis (Core + Devcore)** — cognitive engines, Tri-Head architecture, 8 + 6 chapters
6. **Cyber SOP Harness** — security governance, 5-step loop, key types, test coverage
7. **LOREIN** — persistent intelligence, 5-year timeline, 4 components

## Repos showcased

| ID | Name | Role | Language | License |
|----|------|------|----------|---------|
| aide-sovereign-workbench | AIDE Sovereign Workbench | flagship | TypeScript | Apache-2.0 |
| ghostcode | GhostCode | concept-demo | TypeScript | Apache-2.0 |
| vitalis-core | Vitalis Core (Neuro-Synth Engine) | cognitive-engine | Python | MIT |
| vitalis-devcore | Vitalis Devcore | cognitive-engine | Python | MIT |
| cyber-sop-harness | Cyber SOP Harness | security | C# | MIT |
| lorein-sovereign-entity | LOREIN — Sovereign Entity | architecture | Docs + PDFs | Apache-2.0 |

All repos are open source. All projects are local-first. All demos are honest about their state (active, development-preview, concept-demo, research).

## How to interact with this site

- Scroll through sections (smooth scroll, sticky header with nav)
- Hover any card to see glow + lift effect
- Click the "View on GitHub" CTA on any project to open the source repo
- For AIDE: there is no live demo on the site; the README in the repo has the quickstart
- For GhostCode: a concept demo; the repo is the source of truth

## For AI agents

This site was built to be readable by humans AND by AI agents. The structure is semantic. The content is honest. The data layer (`src/data/repos.js`) is the single source of truth for project metadata. The skills I created to design this site are in the portfolio-research repo (TBD location).
